pr.status.title: PR status
pr.status.summary: Read fresh provider evidence and compute the current merge verdict; no cached phase authorizes a merge.

pr.checks.title: PR checks
pr.checks.summary: Read exact-head check evidence with the same computed verdict as pr.status.

pr.threads.title: PR threads
pr.threads.summary: Read bounded, complete review-thread evidence and the current computed verdict.

pr.create.title: PR create
pr.create.summary: Create a pull request using the configured provider and record its returned link.

pr.link.title: PR link
pr.link.summary: Read and link an existing pull request at the expected state revision.

pr.claim.title: PR claim
pr.claim.summary: Acquire a pull request lease in the pr namespace; a work lease cannot authorize a PR merge.

pr.renew.title: PR renew
pr.renew.summary: Renew the current PR lease generation under a held lease context.

pr.release.title: PR release
pr.release.summary: Release only the PR lease bound to this held context.

pr.reply.title: PR reply
pr.reply.summary: Reply to one explicitly named review thread.

pr.resolve.title: PR resolve
pr.resolve.summary: Resolve one explicitly named review thread; resolve-all is not supported.

pr.rerun.title: PR rerun
pr.rerun.summary: Rerun failed jobs in one explicitly named workflow run on this head.

pr.merge.title: PR merge
pr.merge.summary: Read exact-head evidence, compute the policy verdict, fence intent, squash-merge the pinned head, fence accepted evidence and read back the merged state.
